summary.text: Cassie Blausey is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 29 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Chris Lewis (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lawyer and former teacher whose work in education policy shaped her campaign.

paragraphs.text: Blausey said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is a lawyer by trade and a teacher at heart, and that her education policy work gave her insight into the challenges facing local families.
She described herself as a former teacher and union member, and said she would work with labor to repeal Kentucky's right-to-work law.
Her other stated priorities were responding to federal Medicaid cuts and increasing funding for Kentucky public schools.
